summary.text: Mike Vinton is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 40, first elected in 2024, and a business owner seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Gabriel Bradshaw.

paragraphs.text: Vinton earned a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from Montana Tech and a master's degree in business administration.
His career includes owning Vinton Construction Inc. and working in the engineering field.
Vinton won the 2024 general election for the open District 40 seat, defeating Bob Auch, 74.5 percent to 25.5 percent.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee.
He defeated Gunner Cesnik in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, 67.8 percent to 32.2 percent.
